name: you
description: You: the settings page, four rows in three groups, each a link to its own screen, with the destinations and the foot line. One render for every platform; desktop puts the masthead and the destinations in the title block beside the page.

platform.description: The device the page is drawn for. Desktop's rule: the masthead (wordmark, keybox) and the destinations are the title block (mast form title) beside the page (shell layout sidebar). Mobile and tablet: the header section (masthead row and destinations) inside the page.

noRule.mobile: a page has no CSS: the platform chooses which modules it composes and how
noRule.tablet: a page has no CSS: the platform chooses which modules it composes and how
noRule.desktop: a page has no CSS: the platform chooses which modules it composes and how

state.description: The page's states (journal-website.html #you). The settings page has one.

noRule.default: a page has no CSS: a state chooses the content and modules it composes
noRule.loading: a page has no CSS: a state chooses what it composes

context.description: Where the page is drawn. screen: the numbered screens (the static header). walkthrough: the prototypes and the website; below desktop a page with the header section draws it in its navbar form and puts its blocks in the page's reader (layout page, option reader). Pages without the header section draw the same in both.

noRule.screen: a page has no CSS: the context chooses how it composes its modules
noRule.walkthrough: a page has no CSS: the context chooses how it composes its modules

data.description: data.mjs: the masthead, the destinations, the settings groups and rows, and the foot line (07-you). Real copy: a page is not stress-tested (its components are).

states.default: yes: the settings rows as written
states.hover: n/a: a page; its controls carry their own
states.focus-visible: n/a: a page; its controls carry their own
states.active: n/a: a page; its controls carry their own
states.disabled: n/a: a page; its controls carry their own
states.selected: n/a: a page; its controls carry their own
states.loading: yes: you-loading, the labels and headings real, the keeping date, each row's line and value in bone, no row a link yet; "Loading your settings." announced; no foot
states.error: n/a: the page's failure states arrive with the state packs
states.empty: n/a: the settings page is never empty

a11y.role: none of its own: the masthead (header), destinations (nav) and the settings (main) are its landmarks

responsive.1200: desktop: the masthead and destinations become the title block beside the page

changelog.change: Pages round 2: 07-you (the settings page) on the three platforms, at parity with the screens.
Variant context (screen, walkthrough): the walkthroughs render the page directly (pages round 5).
v4 round 10: loading is a skeleton (bone, system/content/skeleton.mjs) in the page's real frame, in place of the one-line state message.
v4 round 10 fixes 5: the keeping date and each row's line in bone too, as What it sees.
